question: 按大区统计GMV
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, SUM(f.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id=r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name

question: 按省份统计销售额
gold_sql: SELECT r.province AS 省份, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id=r.region_id GROUP BY r.province

question: 按会员等级统计订单数
gold_sql: SELECT c.member_level AS 会员等级, COUNT(f.order_id) AS 订单数 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.member_level

question: 按商品品类汇总GMV
gold_sql: SELECT p.category AS 品类, SUM(f.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: 按品牌统计销量
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand AS 品牌, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS 销量 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.brand

question: 按性别统计订单金额
gold_sql: SELECT c.gender AS 性别, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 金额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender

question: 销售额最高的5个商品
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name AS 商品, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 5

question: GMV最低的3个省份
gold_sql: SELECT r.province AS 省份, SUM(f.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id=r.region_id GROUP BY r.province ORDER BY GMV ASC LIMIT 3

question: 订单数最多的3个大区
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, COUNT(f.order_id) AS 订单数 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id=r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY 订单数 DESC LIMIT 3

question: 销售额前5的品牌
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand AS 品牌, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 销量最高的3个品类
gold_sql: SELECT p.category AS 品类, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS 销量 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 3

question: 客单价最高的3个会员等级
